title: Virtue ethics in daily life
competency: Apply virtue ethics in daily life.

keywords.def: Understanding another person's feelings and wanting to act for their good.
Giving time, effort and resources for the benefit of others.

en.text: We practise virtues at home, at school and in the community: honesty, compassion, fairness, prudence, generosity and self-discipline. Abebech Gobena, "Africa's Mother Teresa", began by picking up abandoned babies and built an organization serving over 12,000 children, showing compassion, generosity and commitment.

am.text: በጎ ምግባሮችን በቤት፣ በትምህርት ቤትና በማኅበረሰብ እንለማመዳለን። አበበች ጎበና በአንድ የርኅራኄ ተግባር ጀምራ ከ12,000 በላይ ሕፃናትን አገልግላለች።

screens.title: One act of kindness
screens.ask: One woman picked up an abandoned baby on a journey to Wollo. Years later her organization served over 12,000 children. What started it?
screens.after: One act of compassion grew. This is the story of Abebech Gobena.

people.name: Abebech Gobena
people.did: Founded Ethiopia's first orphanage. Called "Africa's Mother Teresa". Raised children with her own money; her organization now serves over 12,000 children.

screens.title: Her story
paras: She brought home 21 children in one year and raised them with her own money.
They grew to 200. Her organization now has six branches serving over 12,000 children.
"Commitment is everything to me," she said. She sold her gold and remade her dresses for the children.

screens.text: Which virtues did Abebech Gobena show?
screens.why: She cared for abandoned children, gave her own money and kept going without knowing how.

screens.text: In a school club a new student sits alone. Which action practises TWO virtues at once?
opts: Invite him to join and share your snack
screens.ans: Invite him to join and share your snack
screens.why: Inviting him shows compassion; sharing shows generosity.
